entities.summary: Said-Khasan Said-Magomedovich Abumuslimov is a Chechen historian, writer and publicist. From 1996 to 1997, he was acting Vice President of the breakaway Chechen Republic of Ichkeria under Acting President Zelimkhan Yandarbiyev.
